description: Defines the abstract class rx::ProgramImpl and related classes for handling shader program linking, validation, and uniform setting in ANGLE graphics library.

classes.name: LinkEvent
classes.description: Abstract class for asynchronous linking events.

classes.name: LinkEventDone
classes.description: Concrete class representing a completed link event.

classes.name: ProgramImpl
classes.description: Abstract base class for program implementation handling linking, validation, and uniforms.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for the linking to complete, returns the result.

methods.name: isLinking
methods.description: Checks if linking is still ongoing.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads program data from a binary stream.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves program data to a binary stream.

methods.name: setBinaryRetrievableHint
methods.description: Sets whether the binary is retrievable.

methods.name: setSeparable
methods.description: Sets whether the program is separable.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the program against device capabilities.

methods.name: setUniform*
methods.description: Sets uniform variables of various types.

methods.name: setPathFragmentInputGen
methods.description: Sets parameters for fragment shader input variable interpolation.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the program state with the context.
